native: CPM, makeNetworks, tensorDecomposition, strictDirection, heatKernel, hkManifoldAlignment, knockoutDirection
refit_schedule: 20 x 80% distinct patients, all five LODO, seed456, assigned existing states, identical panel subject to local coverage gate. Same fit used for both KOs.
endpoint_gate: State or pooled fits >=80 cells and >=4 patients. Gene >=10 positive cells, at least 3 positive patients, positive raw variance. Source needs outgoing WT edge, endpoint directed-reachable. Full heat kernel symmetrizes WT, direct edges not implied.
rank: rank by decreasing heat distance, all non-KO model genes including disconnected, ties averaged
direction: Native knockoutDirection unadjusted is primary. Package regressLibSize=TRUE and a diagnostic removing expression PC1 on depth residuals are run independently. PC1 diagnostic uses same formula, labelled sensitivity only.
patient_readout: Fixed pooled WT heat kernel, patient-specific empirical mean and SD via native hkManifoldAlignment. >=10 cells, nonconstant detected source and endpoint; no patient-level direction from fixed kernel. Patient median reported apart from pooled network statistic.
controls: 5 nearest TFs per KO, among expressed human TFs with WT outdegree>0, exclude registered endpoints/program members. Euclidean standardized log1p(mean counts), detection fraction, log1p(degree); ties alphabetical
program: Median distance over covered reachable non-KO members. >=3 and >=50% of frozen list required. Full panel footprint explicitly reported. MP10 M20 empty by definition.
threads: up to three separate fits simultaneously each using up to 3 CPU threads; CPU affinity global 0-9, individual address-space cap 38 GB, total < 190 GB. Pilot alone.
selection: Before any KO result. Official CellOracle not in existing 3.10 environments. Clean install failed during velocyto metadata; bootstrapped retry progressed but full stack not installed. Official hg38_gimmemotifsv5_fpr2 fetch failed integrity/completion from upstream and CDN. Official CRAN fallback installed in isolated local Rlib.
